name: yahoo-quote-kr-listings
note: Hand-made, not recorded (Yahoo answers only yahoo-finance2's own User-Agent, and none was recorded here): Yahoo's v7 quote answer for the Korean listings the instrument search's OpenDART matches are placed by, in the shape yahoo-finance2 4.0.6's quote schema validates (the rows of yahoo/quote-005930-ks.json and yahoo/quote-035900-kq.json, and rows of the same form for 005935.KS, 006400.KS, 009150.KS, 028260.KS, 000660.KS and 035720.KS), with invented prices as of 2026-11-25. A batched request is answered with the rows of the symbols it asks for that this answer holds, as Yahoo leaves out symbols it does not know.
